stories.title: Iran plans to announce an 'exclusion zone' near the Strait of Hormuz
stories.reason: The zone would run from the US naval blockade line into the Persian Gulf, with any vessel entering it while trying to transit Hormuz added to Iran's sanctions list -- a direct counter-move a day after the US destroyed three of its oil tankers.

stories.title: Witkoff and Kushner leave Kyiv pushing a 'refreshed' peace proposal after no Moscow breakthrough
stories.reason: Despite three hours with Putin producing no announced breakthrough, the envoys called their Kyiv talks with Zelenskyy 'encouraging' and say next steps will be announced in the coming weeks, with both sides open to reviving trilateral talks.

stories.title: Armed man charges toward Ohio gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton at campaign event, injuring several
stories.reason: The suspect, carrying two legally-owned pistols and brass knuckles, knocked down two elderly attendees while shoving toward Acton at the Canfield Fair, the latest incident to raise alarm about political violence ahead of the midterms.

stories.title: Missouri Supreme Court blocks Trump-backed congressional map, orders a statewide referendum
stories.reason: The unanimous ruling keeps the pre-2025 map in effect for November's election while voters decide the new one's fate, and Missouri's attorney general says she'll appeal to the US Supreme Court.

stories.title: China's Galactic Energy reaches orbit with its Pallas-1 rocket on its debut flight
stories.reason: The success puts another Chinese private company on a path toward reusable orbital launch, intensifying competition with SpaceX's Falcon 9 as more than a dozen Chinese firms race toward booster recovery this year.

stories.title: Broadcom's AI chip revenue soars 221% to $16.7 billion, with guidance implying $230 billion by 2028
stories.reason: Management says demand for custom AI chips continues to outstrip supply, underscoring how far the AI infrastructure buildout still has to run even as some investors question its pace.

stories.title: China's Moonshot AI files for a $3 billion Hong Kong IPO at a $50 billion valuation
stories.reason: The maker of the 2.8-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 model would list well behind rivals DeepSeek ($74B) and Z.AI ($66B), highlighting how crowded and capital-intensive China's AI startup race has become.

stories.title: Sweden's election tightens to a razor-thin margin 11 days before the September 13 vote
stories.reason: A new poll puts the centre-left opposition at 50.3% against the governing right-wing coalition's 47.7%, the smallest gap of the campaign, setting up a genuine toss-up in one of Europe's most closely watched elections.
